## Answers

A1.1          | Tapping "Définir comme référence" in a race's detail screen.
A1.2          | The tapped race; the race currently holding the reference mark (the previous reference); the tapped race's completion status; whether the tapped race is already the current reference.
A1.3          | The tapped race becomes the current reference (mark set on it); the previous reference race has its mark removed; the button's shown/hidden state changes accordingly on both the detail screen and the list card for both races.
A1.4          | Race detail screen — the "Définir comme référence" button; race list screen — the same button on the race's list card.
A1.5          | Not applicable — the block does not sort, rank, or pick a most recent.
A1.6          | Not applicable — the trigger is a one-off tap, not a persisting condition; the resulting mark persists until the mechanism fires again on another race.
A1.7          | The previous reference's mark is removed (not kept) once a new race is set as reference.
A1.8          | Yes — tapping the button on a different eligible race (complete, not already the reference) re-fires it, moving the mark to that race; each firing is a new state, not a return to an earlier one.
A2.persistence.1 | Stored — the reference designation persists on the race until this same action moves it elsewhere.
A2.persistence.2 | gap: the block does not say what becomes of the reference designation if the race or reference structure changes.
A2.persistence.3 | Not applicable — the reference mark is all-or-nothing (set or not); no partial/incomplete form is described.
A3            | Ruled out — the block has a trigger (see A1.1), it is not a reference table.
A4.1          | The attribute the block owns (the reference designation and its removal) is defined by the action described here.
A4.2          | The cited destinations (the race, the detail screen, the list card, the "incomplete" status) are named without further content asserted about them here; recorded in the index for cross-check.
A4.3          | Not applicable — the block uses no comparative qualifier ("more", "less", "recent", etc.).

## Index

Consumes  | the tapped race, the race currently holding the reference mark (previous reference), the tapped race's completion status, whether the tapped race is already the current reference
Produces  | reference mark set on the tapped race, reference mark removed from the previous reference, button shown/hidden state on the race detail screen, button shown/hidden state on the race list card
Draws on  | race detail screen — "Définir comme référence" button; race list screen — list card action area
Names     | current reference = the race designated by this mechanism as reference; "Définir comme référence" = the button's exact label; incomplete = the race's completion status gating the button's visibility; list card = the race's representation on the race list screen; detail screen = the race's detail screen
Reads at  | the moment the user taps "Définir comme référence"
Writes at | the moment that tap is processed
